question: What happens when consciousness abides pervading all objects by the mere desire to see?
premises: Consciousness can abide pervading all objects.
This can occur through the mere desire to see.
The Spanda teaching says no further elaboration is needed then.
inference: When pervading awareness is present, elaborate explanation becomes unnecessary.
plain_english: When, by the mere desire to see, consciousness abides pervading all objects, what more needs to be said? So it is taught in the Spanda scripture.
